Strike trees the fire-weather winds would throw into the line

Source: R/plot.R
plot_wind_exposure.Rd

Map of potential strike trees (under one conductor bound) coloured by the share of fire-weather hours whose wind would push them into the line, over the canopy height model, with a wind rose of those hours.

Usage

plot_wind_exposure(
  risk,
  rasters = NULL,
  bound = c("lo", "hi"),
  title = NULL,
  file = NULL
)

Arguments

risk

Output of wind_fall_exposure().

rasters

Output of corridor_rasters(), optional (canopy backdrop).

bound

"lo" or "hi": conductor bound defining the strike trees.

title

Plot title; NULL states the windward count.

file

Output PNG path, or NULL.
